question: Where can I find hotel inside 90 kilometers while progressing from Children's Hospital at Montefiore, Bronx, NY toward Coastal Living LLC‎, Brielle, NJ?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.878898 40.880372)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.059149 40.107405)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.878898 40.880372)',4326)::geography, 90000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.878898 40.880372)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
